messages:
sam: noticed a cluster of SSE reconnects that produced short duplicate tails after we flipped the eviction policy. looks like aggressive evict -> immediate reassign is causing resume replays.
rita: can you paste the trace?
sam: short sanitized snippet:
```
2026-08-14T14:22:01Z session=acct-11 conn=sse-321 prox=edge-us-2 evict=immediate reason=quota_spike
2026-08-14T14:22:01Z conn=sse-321 close=1001 reason=evicted route_reassign=edge-us-2->edge-us-5
2026-08-14T14:22:01Z session=acct-11 reconnect=1 resume=rt:abcd seq=901 billing_check=miss
```
devon: so two problems: eviction timing and metadata replication. dedupe keys include route_owner so swap breaks it.
anya: console/telemetry ask: we only show disconnect counts today. we should emit `edge.eviction.v2` with fields {session, orig_owner, new_owner, reason, drift_ms} and render a red "Evicted" annotation on the request timeline.
sam: good. also need a `resume.dup_fragment` counter per-tenant to know if reconnects are causing client-visible duplicates.
rita: mitigation ideas: 1) adaptive drain window before steal (give active streams 50-300ms), 2) add short-lived kvcache dedupe table across pools, 3) include signed origin_hint in resume token.
devon: adaptive drain feels low-friction: delay reclaim slightly for streams with active writes. but for quota spikes we sometimes need instant reclaim. propose adaptive rule: if eviction.reason==quota_spike && stream_rate>threshold then immediate, else drain 100ms.
anya: console UX: show a policy tag on the route chart: "evict:adaptive(100ms)" vs "evict:immediate" so SREs can correlate behavior to rollout flag.
sam: billing impact: kvcache dedupe is safest long-term. cheap TTL of 30s should cover most reconnect windows. behind feature flag `billing.resume_kv_v1`.
rita: short-term hotfix: extend server dedupe grace for resumes that immediately follow an eviction event by +1s. This prevents the worst duplicates while we implement kvcache.
devon: agree. also ensure edge emits `eviction.signature` in resume token so billing can validate origin without exposing internal ids. small token bump.
anya: console: we should add an alert when `resume.dupe_rate` > 0.1% over 5m with link to query showing `edge.eviction.v2` events. add it to tenant ops dashboard.
sam: rollout plan: 1) emit eviction telemetry (no behavior change) - 48h baseline. 2) hotfix dedupe grace +1s on server - immediate canary. 3) kvcache dedupe canary 5% -> 50% -> full. 4) adaptive drain flag behind `streaming.adaptive_evict.v1`. 5) token origin_hint as medium-term.
rita: ops: can you revert eviction policy in eu-west canary until we ship hotfix?
ops-bot: reverted eviction policy to previous behavior in eu-west canary at 14:45 UTC. created INF-9500 and linked this thread.
devon: QA: provide query to find sessions where edge.eviction.v2 exists && resume.dup_fragment > 0 && billing.charge_duplicate=true. I'll add example to INF-9500.
anya: also add a small UI drilldown: clicking the eviction annotation shows orig_owner/new_owner and a link to recent resume attempts for that session.
sam: owners: devon(edge + token), rita(billing), anya(console). ETA: hotfix + telemetry by EOD, kvcache POC next sprint.
devon: will open PRs and post links in INF-9500.
rita: thanks. follow-up: once kvcache lands, we'll retire the server +1s grace.
ops-bot: INF-9500 created: edge: emit eviction.v2, hotfix dedupe grace, billing: kvcache POC, console: eviction annotations and resume.dupe_rate panel. Owners assigned.
sam: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for PR links and rollouts. :thumbsup:
